result:
This looks clean and correctly scoped. Both `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` pass.

## Summary

`GET /health` now performs a real database round trip instead of returning a static `200 {"status":"ok"}`:

- **`app/Support/HealthCheck.ts`** (new) — `checkDatabaseConnection()` opens the app's real database (via `getDatabase()` from `config/database.ts`) and runs a trivial `select 1` through Drizzle's `sql` tag, catching any failure (unreachable connection, thrown query, etc.) and returning `{ status: 'ok' }` or `{ status: 'error', message }`. It takes an injectable resolver so tests can simulate a broken database without touching the real one.
- **`app/Http/Controllers/HealthController.ts`** (new) — calls the check and responds `200 { status: "ok", checks: { db: { status: "ok" } } }` when it passes, or `503 { status: "error", checks: { db: { status: "error", message } } }` when it fails.
- **`routes/web.ts`** — `/health` now routes to `HealthController@index` instead of the inline `c.json({status:'ok'})` handler; still unauthenticated and still exempt from host authorization (unchanged in `src/app.ts`).
- **Tests** — `tests/HealthController.test.ts` (new) unit-tests the success/failure branches of `checkDatabaseConnection` directly (query throws, connection open throws), and `tests/HomeController.test.ts` now asserts the `/health` response body shape (`status`/`checks.db.status`) on the happy path against the real test database.
